install_xla: install torch_xla wheels in Google Colab based on the current torch version
install_xla_upgrade: upgrade torch and install the latest torch_xla wheels in Google Colab
install_xla_colab_check: check if running in Google Colab before installing torch_xla
install_xla_version_detection: detect the current torch version and construct the matching torch_xla wheel URL
install_xla_runtime_error: raise a runtime error when install_xla is called outside of Google Colab
